name: quote-rail
title: Quote rail
description: Testimonial cards in one sideways rail that snaps card by card, with previous and next buttons, for more quotes than room, and nothing that moves by itself.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and items ({ id, quote, name, role, avatar?, rating? }); six to twelve read well. Cards share one readable width and one height, with the person pinned to the bottom. It is the browser's own scrolling with scroll snapping, so touch, trackpad and the arrow keys work with no script (the rail is a focusable list named by the heading) and nothing ever autoplays. Two round buttons step one card back or on and rest at the ends (aria-disabled, still in the tab order); they sit at the end of the heading row from 640px and under the heading on a phone, so the title keeps the full width; after a press a polite live region says 'Quote 3 of 9' or 'Quotes 3 to 5 of 9', and a thin line with a count under the rail shows the position. On a phone the rail runs to the screen edge so the next card peeks in: set --rail-gutter on the section to your page's side padding (default 1.5rem). labels carries the fixed words, locale the numbers.
